translations.synopsis: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a 2026 first-person shooter game developed by Infinity Ward and published by Activision. It is the twenty-third installment in the Call of Duty series and the fourth and final entry in the rebooted Modern Warfare sub-series, following Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III (2023). It was released on October 23, 2026, for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S. Prior to release, Modern Warfare 4 received positive reviews from critics, with praise for its campaign mode.
translations.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
